description: This Java source file defines the class MacroCallMatcher, which extends TypeSafeMatcher to provide custom matching logic for RenderableFtl macro call objects, primarily used in testing to verify macro name and parameters.

classes.name: MacroCallMatcher
classes.description: A custom Matcher for verifying macro call objects with specific macro name and parameter matchers.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Overrides the method to determine if the provided RenderableFtl matches the expected macro name and parameter conditions.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Describes the expected macro call for test failure output.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Provides detailed mismatch information when the actual macro call does not meet expectations.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher that checks for a macro call with a specific name.

methods.name: hasParameters
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher that checks for macro parameters matching given parameter matchers.

methods.name: hasNameAndParameters
methods.description: Static factory method to create a matcher that checks for a macro call with a specific name and parameters.
